targets.title: Expected Stock Returns and Variance Risk Premia
targets.evidence_quote: Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate a claim from Bollerslev_RevFinStudies_2009_QllV
targets.outcome_quote: Main: This claim was not replicated. The coefficient on the ‘diff’ (difference between IV and RV) is (positive) 0.07455682, but its p-value is 0.54497 (greater than 0.05).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The preregistered main test explicitly failed. The successful additional pre-Covid subsample is labelled a robustness test and is not the central preregistered test, so it is excluded under the central-finding rule.

reasoning: Full primary SCORE report identified through OSF file GUID and verified against project contributors. New-period secondary data are a different sample, not original-data reproduction. The report describes January 2008–December 2020 data and an additional pre-Covid subsample. Original authors transcribed surname-first from the full reference.
